headline: London Copper Prices Bounce Over 3% Amid Weaker US Dollar
summary: London copper prices increased more than 3% from Wednesday lows amid a sharply weaker US dollar during a thin holiday trading week.
why: Copper is a heavily traded industrial metal and a key economic barometer, making price swings significant for mining companies and broader manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: London copper prices rose over 3% from their lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Cross-asset sentiment firmed with no obvious catalyst beyond a sharply weaker US dollar, resulting in a relief rally driven by stretched positioning during a thin holiday trading week.
